summary: Life sentence for murder under IPC s.302 read with s.34; concurrent convictions upheld despite acquittal of third accused; sole eyewitness testimony (mother) deemed credible despite belated recording; corroboration from disclosure statements, recovery of blood-stained weapons; delay in witness examination justified per Satish (2005); parity argument rejected as High Court found differential evidence; impugned judgment affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.161, s.313
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; concurrent convictions upheld; life sentence with fine sustained.
